description_en: Queries the consumption status of a consumer group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka get-consumer-progress --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-mp919o4v0000 --consumer-id kafka-test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --hide-last-timestamp true --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConsumerProgress

parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to hide the \`LastTimestamp\` parameter. The default value is false. Set this parameter to true for better performance.

> - If you set this parameter to true, -1 is returned for the \`LastTimestamp\` parameter. Otherwise, a specific value is returned. This parameter is supported only for topics of cloud storage on provisioned instances.
>
> - This operation processes a large amount of data and consumes a high degree of performance. Set this parameter to true to reduce the processing time
parameters.help_zh:
是否隐藏 LastTimestamp，默认值为 false，建议设置为 true。


> 
> - 若设置为 true，则返回参数中的 LastTimestamp 会返回为 -1，反之则返回具体的值。仅支持预留实例云存储类型的 Topic。
> - 该接口处理数据较多，比较损耗性能，建议设置为 true，可加快处理时间
parameters.name: hide_last_timestamp
